content.title: Key Takeaways
items: Content repurposing is not copying the same paragraph into different channels — it means transforming one core knowledge asset into multiple context-appropriate formats, each respecting its own audience, platform, and purpose.

Every repurposed asset should preserve the approved meaning of its source: the same facts, numbers, qualifications, warnings, and context — even when the format, wording, and length change substantially.
Repurposing should always start from an approved, current, accurate source asset — never from an unapproved draft treated as though it were finished, verified knowledge.

Breaking a source into "knowledge atoms" (definitions, facts, steps, warnings, and similar discrete units) is what makes systematic, traceable repurposing possible, rather than ad hoc summarizing from memory.

If a shorter format genuinely cannot preserve the necessary context of a claim, do not force the repurposing — use a longer format instead, link back to the original, or route the content to expert review.

The goal is not content volume. It's extracting more value from knowledge that has already been researched, reviewed, and approved — a small number of well-adapted derivatives beats a large number of careless ones.

content.content: A local business often spends real effort creating one genuinely useful piece of content, publishes it once, and then starts researching the next topic completely from zero. Build one strong source asset, then systematically extract and reuse its knowledge across an FAQ, a checklist, an email, a short educational post, a video outline, and other formats.

items.definition: The systematic process of using AI to extract key points from an approved source asset, classify discrete knowledge atoms, and adapt them into multiple format-specific derivative assets while preserving core meaning and factual accuracy.

content.content: Human review remains necessary at every stage. AI accelerates extraction, drafting, and organization — it does not independently verify that a derivative asset has preserved the source's meaning.

rows: Refresh or improve existing content in same format
Extend asset's knowledge into a different format
Stays largely the same (article to article)
Adapted to new context, channel, or use case
Restructured entirely to fit new format

content.content: Duplication means the same paragraph pasted into different channels unchanged. Repurposing means reshaping the underlying knowledge into a new format adapted for a specific context.

A single strong, well-researched original article contains enough underlying knowledge to support several smaller, genuinely useful derivative assets — reducing repeated research and inconsistent messaging across channels.

content.title: 6. Start With a Strong Source Asset

content.content: Good candidates: approved guides, tutorials, documented workflows, checklists, and case studies. Repurposing a weak or unverified source just spreads its weaknesses further.
Audit the source before repurposing: Is content approved? Are claims verified? Are sources recorded? Are dynamic facts dated? Is it still current?
Break the source into reusable units: Definition, Fact, Question, Answer, Step, Process, Example, Warning, Insight, Statistic, Principle, Checklist Item, and Prompt.

Choose formats based on user intent, complexity, platform, audience, content lifecycle, and business goal. Simple, low-risk atoms suit short formats; complex or high-risk atoms require longer formats or direct links to the source.
Convert extracted definitions or questions into validated FAQ entries while preserving qualifications and source citations.
Convert process steps into actionable checklist items without stripping important conditions or timing qualifications.
Adapt key insights into clear short-form structures (Problem → Insight → Action) without resorting to oversimplification or sensationalism.
Structure long content into conversational educational emails, FAQ emails, or summary emails adapted for fast scanning.
Map article structures to video outlines (Hook → Problem → Key Ideas → Action) without fabricating new claims.
Design workflow diagrams, checklist visuals, or process graphics that preserve original factual relationships accurately.
Adapt public guides into staff onboarding material, customer service scripts, or internal SOP support.
Extract individual tips or insights for newsletter sections while keeping necessary context intact.
Identify supporting glossary terms, resource pages, or service-page content opportunities based on genuine user value.
Maintain a canonical record for each source asset tracking Source ID, Title, URL, Status, Author, Dates, Industry, Audience, Key Claims, and Sources.
Track every derivative asset with Asset ID, Source ID, Format, Title, Audience, Purpose, Source Section, Risk Level, Status, and Reviewer.
Score derivative ideas (0=Low, 1=Med, 2=High) across Audience Value, Business Relevance, Source Strength, Effort, Reusability, Freshness, and Risk.

content.title: AI Prompt Template: Knowledge Atom Extractor
content.prompt:
You are helping a local business extract knowledge atoms from an approved source asset.

APPROVED SOURCE CONTENT: [insert full source content]

Please identify and organize: Definitions, Facts, Questions, Steps, Examples, Warnings, Insights, Statistics, Principles, Checklist Items. Preserve qualifications, risk levels, and source sections.

content.title: AI Prompt Template: Repurposing Matrix Generator
content.prompt:
You are helping a local business build a repurposing matrix from a knowledge atom inventory.

KNOWLEDGE ATOM INVENTORY: [insert]

Suggest appropriate format, audience, purpose, required adaptation, and review requirements for each atom. Flag atoms requiring direct source linking.

content.title: AI Prompt Template: Content Repurposing Generator
content.prompt:
You are helping a local business create a specific piece of repurposed content.

CANONICAL SOURCE: [insert source]
KNOWLEDGE ATOMS TO USE: [insert]
TARGET FORMAT: [FAQ / checklist / email / short educational post / video outline / visual / newsletter]
AUDIENCE: [insert]

Produce derivative content preserving exact source facts, numbers, qualifications, and warnings. Adapt tone, length, and structure for target format.

content.title: 27. AI Prompt — Repurposed Content Integrity Auditor
AI Prompt Template: Repurposed Content Integrity Auditor
content.prompt:
You are auditing a piece of repurposed content against its canonical source for integrity.

SOURCE CONTENT: [insert source]
REPURPOSED CONTENT: [insert derivative]

Check factual consistency, meaning consistency, numerical match, qualification preservation, and warning preservation. Output result: PASS, PARTIAL, or FAIL.

content.title: AI Prompt Template: Repurposing Opportunity Finder
content.prompt:
You are helping a local business identify repurposing opportunities from a complete, approved article.

APPROVED ARTICLE: [insert article]

Identify opportunities for FAQs, checklists, workflows, newsletters, video outlines, visuals, and glossaries. List section source, audience, effort, and priority.

content.content: Deriving patient FAQs, preparation checklists, educational emails, and video outlines from an approved oral health guide while preserving non-clinical framing and professional disclaimers.
Deriving legal FAQs, process checklists, and educational emails from an attorney-approved legal guide, with ABA Formal Opinion 512 attorney review gates and jurisdictional cautions preserved.
Deriving buyer FAQs, buyer checklists, and local market newsletters from an approved homebuying guide, with HUD 2024 Fair Housing Act compliance reviews and dynamic date stamps intact.

items: Canonical source approved, current, and verified
Knowledge atoms extracted with warnings and qualifications intact
Target format fits atom complexity and user intent
Derivative facts, numbers, and sources match original source
Human review completed (expert review for high-risk topics)
Derivative linked to canonical source record with update triggers

content.content: Maintain a parent-child mapping of Canonical Articles to FAQs, Checklists, Emails, Videos, Visuals, and Resources to ensure source updates propagate to all dependent assets.
Track repurposing rate, source-to-asset ratio, production time savings, update propagation speed, content integrity audit error rates, and audience engagement by format.

content.title: 10 Common Repurposing Mistakes
content.content:
1. Repurposing unapproved or stale content
2. Copying paragraphs instead of adapting structure for context
3. Stripping out essential qualifications or warnings
4. Altering factual claims or numbers during adaptation
5. Inventing statistics, quotes, or testimonials
6. Creating too many low-quality derivative assets
7. Publishing identical content on all channels
8. Forgetting source traceability and dependency tracking
9. Skipping human review on derivative drafts
10. Repurposing dynamic facts without checking currency

steps.title: Week 1 — Select Canonical Source Asset
steps.content: Select one approved canonical source asset using audit criteria.

steps.title: Week 2 — Extract Atoms & Build Matrix
steps.content: Extract knowledge atoms and generate repurposing matrix.

steps.title: Week 3 — Create & Review Derivatives
steps.content: Draft, audit, and review 2–3 derivative assets.

steps.title: Week 4 — Assess, Update & Standardize
steps.content: Assess performance, update canonical source, and document workflow.

content.title: 39. What AI Can and Cannot Do

pros: Extract knowledge atoms from approved sources
Classify content and suggest repurposing formats
Adapt structure and tone for target formats
Audit derivative content integrity against source
cons: Cannot guarantee factual, legal, medical, financial, or Fair Housing accuracy
Cannot replace human domain review for high-risk topics
Cannot guarantee search rankings, citations, or leads

items.question: What is AI content repurposing?
items.answer: AI content repurposing is transforming one approved source asset into multiple formats — FAQs, checklists, emails, videos — while preserving original facts, context, and qualifications using AI assistance.

items.question: What is the difference between repurposing and rewriting?
items.answer: Rewriting refreshes content in the same format. Repurposing adapts underlying knowledge into a genuinely different format for a new context or platform.

items.question: How do knowledge atoms support repurposing?
items.answer: Knowledge atoms break a source into discrete units (definitions, facts, steps, warnings) with risk and source tags, making systematic, traceable adaptation possible.

items.question: What happens when the original source article is updated?
items.answer: All dependent derivative assets mapped in the Repurposing Inventory should be audited against the updated source, revised, reviewed, and republished.

content.title: AI Content Update Workflow for Local Businesses
content.description: Repurposed assets must be refreshed as core source assets update.
